_readme: Announcements shown in the launcher's notification bell.
Publishing one is a COMMIT to this file — no deploy, no SSH. The notifier service
(github.com/Gorgorito12/notifier-server) reads it on its next poll and republishes it in
the manifest every launcher already fetches; the launcher bells anything it has not shown
Each entry: { id, title, body, url?, date? }
id     REQUIRED and PERMANENT — it is the dedup key. Never reuse one, and never edit an
id after publishing: a changed id re-announces the item to everybody, and a reused
one silently suppresses the new announcement for everyone who saw the old one.
title  REQUIRED. Shown in bold in the bell row. Keep it short.
body   One or two sentences. The bell is the notice; the link carries the detail.
url    Where clicking goes. Omit it and the launcher opens the project's Discord, which
date   Informational only; ordering follows this file's own order.
Anything without an id or a title is dropped by the server rather than published.
Newest first is the convention. Nobody is re-notified for entries already delivered, so
old ones can stay here as a record.

announcements.title: v1.0.13l: the multiplayer screens, rebuilt
announcements.body: The ranking table was redone and History now lives inside your Profile. There is also a text size setting, and any text cut short with an ellipsis can be read by hovering over it. Notes in English and Spanish.

announcements.title: v1.0.13k: 2v2 and 3v3 now score
announcements.body: Team rating is here, on a ladder of its own. And if the launcher did not recognise Radmin, nobody could join the rooms you hosted - that is fixed. Notes in English and Spanish.
